subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw introduce a model-cost currency contract, and if so should it be per-model, per-provider, or a global display preference?
rationale: The request is useful, but current source treats model costs as USD per million tokens and root policy sets a high bar for new config surface, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Design the currency contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer direction, then implement a single documented currency field with USD default and tests across config, registry, and UI displays.

options.title: Reject new model-cost currency surface
options.body: Keep model estimated costs as USD-only and direct non-USD provider balances through the existing provider usage snapshot/billing-unit path.

options.title: Narrow to UI display preference
options.body: Treat currency as a display-only preference rather than provider/model metadata, accepting that it does not change the numeric cost semantics.

recommendation.title: Design the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer direction, then implement a single documented currency field with USD default and tests across config, registry, and UI displays.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-source history signal for both the UI formatters and config cost contract points to Vincent Koc.
